newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - prices close flat to down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - prices close flat to down.

text.p: U.S. municipal bonds forfeited early gains to some stronger-than-expected economic data and a general lack of interest as players got set to depart for the Thanksgiving Day holiday.
Market sources' estimates of closing levels ranged from unchanged to slightly lower, but they agreed activity was light.
"I'd say we are marginally lower with not a lot of activity going on," a trader said. "It's Wednesday before Thanksgiving, no one really has a compelling reason to get long a lot of stuff."
Munis opened about 1/4 point higher, but ended down 1/8 to 1/4 point, the trader said.
A municipal analyst said both the overall market and high-grade issues ended unchanged. Dollar bonds were up 1/8 point at the open, but faded to nearly even by noon (EST).

In the government market, Treasuries opened on a strong note, but also faded. The benchmark 30-year bond closed down 6/32 at 100-29/32 to yield 6.43 percent. The market closed at 1400 (EST) at PSA The Bond Market Trade Association's recommendation.
"I think you lost it on durable goods and Chicago Purchasing Managers," a trader said. "I think that's what took the bid out of the market."
Durable goods rose 0.1 percent in October, while the November Chicago Purchasing Managers Index rose to 57.6 from 56.9.
As for next week's new issues, a $320 million Los Angeles Harbor Department offering, scheduled for Wednesday dominates, the competitive side. The deal is subject to the alternative minimum tax.
On Tuesday, Pittsburgh, Pa., is expected to sell $167 million of refunding bonds, while San Francisco City and County is slated to sell $131 million bonds.

On the negotiated side, Merrill Lynch & Co is expected to price a $210 million Florida Ports Commission offering, while a $170 million New York State Urban Development Corp deal is expected via Smith Barney & Co. Smith Barney is also expected to price a $166 million Illinois Health Facilities Authority deal.
